'''Frost Protection''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for chestplates. It protects against freezing damage and makes the wearer immune to [[freezing water]].

== Obtaining ==
The [[Prayer of Demeter]] gives Frost Protection II along with Frost Walker II. It is the only source. In 1.12.2 the prayer stores the old <code>main:freezing_protection</code>, which turns into Frost Protection II within two ticks of the chestplate being worn.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_freezing_protection.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
=== Freezing water ===
In the pack, being in water in a frozen biome gives the player Slowness and Darkness and damages them (see [[Freezing water]]). A chestplate with Frost Protection at any level prevents this completely: the check only looks for the enchantment on the chest slot, not its level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/predicate/armour_enchants/freezing_protection.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/environmental/check_freezing_water_conditions.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/environmental/freezing_water.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Freezing damage ===
Against other freezing damage, such as from {{MCW|Powder Snow|powder snow}}, Frost Protection adds 24 points of protection per level. Protection from all sources is capped at 20 points (80% reduction), so level I already gives the maximum.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/freezing_protection.json}}</ref>

Its anvil cost multiplier is 2.
